author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Add a log subscription of type Consolidated Event Logs with retrieval method Syslog Push to the data collector, and select the log fields you want (MID, ICID, DCID and the serial number are always written). Each line is one message at its final disposition and goes to the Email schema: envelope sender, recipients, subject, Message-ID, size, sender IP, direction, status from the final action, the first attachment's name, size and SHA-256, and one threat per engine that flagged the message (anti-virus, AMP, anti-spam, Outbreak Filters, DLP). Verdicts, IDs, policies, the header From, SBRS and DMARC, DKIM and SPF results go to event_metadata. Text mail logs and other subscriptions stay generic. ESA writes times in the appliance's local time with no zone, so they are read as UTC; set the appliance to UTC or adjust. Keys are read by name, including the AsyncOS 14 names (startTime, endTime, sourceAddress). ESA doesn't escape spaces in CEF values, so a key=value pair inside a URL in ESAURLDetails can split that value; the parser doesn't read it. Samples are made up in the layout of Cisco's examples. The parser passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13, and no built-in parser in that tenant matched these lines.
